title.zh: 将布拉干省潘迪市镇锡林巴塔小学的名称变更为Matias Salvador小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Siling Bata Elementary School Situated in the Municipality of Pandi, Province of Bulacan, to Matias Salvador Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Siling Bata Elementary School Situated in the Municipality of Pandi, Province of Bulacan, to Matias Salvador Elementary School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Siling Bata Elementary School Situated tại Thị trấn Pandi, Tỉnh Bulacan thành Trường tiểu học Matias Salvador
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อ Siling Bata Elementary School Situated ในเทศบาล Pandi, จังหวัด Bulacan เป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Matias Salvador
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Siling Bata Elementary School Situated di Kotamadya Pandi, Provinsi Bulacan menjadi Sekolah Dasar Matias Salvador
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Siling Bata Elementary School Situated di Perbandaran Pandi, Wilayah Bulacan menjadi Sekolah Rendah Matias Salvador

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1988/ra_6666_1988.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Siling Bata Elementary School situated in the Municipality of Pandi, Province of Bulacan, is hereby changed to Matias Salvador Memorial Elementary School.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
